entries.en: The exercise asks us to identify the aldose in the diagram.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求我们找出图中的醛糖。

entries.en: The report lists aldosterone concentrations in a separate table.
entries.zh: 报告用一张单独的表列出了醛固酮浓度。

entries.en: The grain section shows a thin layer containing aleurone.
entries.zh: 谷粒切片显示了一层含有糊粉的薄层。

entries.en: The jeweller examined the alexandrite under two different lamps.
entries.zh: 珠宝商在两盏不同的灯下检查了那颗紫翠玉。

entries.en: An algarroba shaded the small well behind the house.
entries.zh: 一棵牧豆树为屋后的小井遮阴。

entries.en: The merchant weighed a sack of algarrobilla before the sale.
entries.zh: 出售前，商人称了一袋阿卡洛比拉豆荚的重量。

entries.en: Adding algin changed the texture of the experimental mixture.
entries.zh: 加入褐藻胶改变了实验混合物的质地。

entries.en: A faded receipt records the purchase of alizarine for the workshop.
entries.zh: 一张褪色的收据记录了作坊购买茜素的情况。

entries.en: The fictional alchemist spent years searching for an alkahest.
entries.zh: 那位虚构的炼金术士花了多年寻找万能溶剂。

entries.en: The technician compared the mixture before and after adding the alkalizer.
entries.zh: 技术员比较了加入碱化剂前后的混合物。

entries.en: She drew an alkane beside the aromatic compound for comparison.
entries.zh: 她在芳香族化合物旁画了一种烷烃，以便比较。

entries.en: The older laboratory notebook records a test for alkapton.
entries.zh: 那本较早的实验记录本记载了一项尿黑酸检测。

entries.en: The student marked the double bond in the alkene.
entries.zh: 学生标出了该烯烃中的双键。

entries.en: Our discussion focused on the structure of this alkylbenzene.
entries.zh: 我们的讨论集中在这种烷基苯的结构上。

entries.en: The analyst found alkylbenzenesulfonate in the detergent sample.
entries.zh: 分析员在洗涤剂样本中发现了烷基苯磺酸盐。

entries.en: The worksheet pairs each alkyne with its structural formula.
entries.zh: 这张练习纸把每种炔烃与其结构式配对列出。

entries.en: The lecturer pointed to the allantois in the embryo model.
entries.zh: 讲师指向胚胎模型中的尿囊。

entries.en: The laboratory recorded the alloantibody result without identifying the donor.
entries.zh: 实验室记录了同种抗体的检测结果，没有注明供者身份。

entries.en: A model of an allosaur dominated the museum entrance.
entries.zh: 博物馆入口处最显眼的是一座异龙模型。

entries.en: The class compared this allotrope with another form of the element.
entries.zh: 全班把这种同素异形体与该元素的另一种形态作了比较。

entries.en: He highlighted the allyl group in the reaction scheme.
entries.zh: 他在反应图式中突出标示了烯丙基。

entries.en: The collector kept the almandine in a padded mineral tray.
entries.zh: 收藏者把铁铝榴石放在带衬垫的矿物托盘里。

entries.en: The alocasia needs more space for its spreading leaves.
entries.zh: 这株海芋需要更多空间来舒展叶片。

entries.en: The lecture included a diagram showing alpha-lipoprotein in blood.
entries.zh: 讲座中有一幅显示血液中高密度脂蛋白的示意图。

entries.en: The inventory lists alpha-naphthol separately from the other isomer.
entries.zh: 库存清单把α-萘酚与另一种异构体分开列出。

entries.en: She tucked a stem of alstroemeria into the mixed bouquet.
entries.zh: 她把一枝六出花属植物插进了混合花束中。

entries.en: The bird's alula is visible in the enlarged photograph.
entries.zh: 放大的照片中可以看见这只鸟的小翼羽。

entries.en: The chemist requested another analysis of the aluminate sample.
entries.zh: 化学家要求再次分析这份铝酸盐样本。

entries.en: The gardener moved the alumroot away from the sunny path.
entries.zh: 园丁把矾根草从阳光充足的小径旁移走了。

entries.en: An amadavat perched on a thin branch inside the aviary.
entries.zh: 鸟舍里，一只梅花雀停在细枝上。

entries.en: The fishmonger placed an amberfish on the crushed ice.
entries.zh: 鱼贩把一条鰤放在了碎冰上。

entries.en: A chipped piece of amblygonite lay among the unlabelled minerals.
entries.zh: 一块有缺口的锂磷铝石混在未贴标签的矿物中。

entries.en: The zoologist traced an ambulacrum across the specimen's underside.
entries.zh: 动物学家沿着标本腹面的一条步带比画。

entries.en: The children watched an ameba move across the microscope image.
entries.zh: 孩子们看着一只变形虫在显微图像中移动。

entries.en: She sketched a hanging ament before drawing the leaves.
entries.zh: 她先画了一条下垂的柔荑花序，再画叶子。

entries.en: The researcher selected an amide for the comparison experiment.
entries.zh: 研究人员选了一种酰胺用于对比实验。

entries.en: The tutor checked the student's drawing of an aminoalkane.
entries.zh: 导师检查了学生画的氨基烷烃结构图。

entries.en: The chart places aminomethane next to two related compounds.
entries.zh: 图表把氨基甲烷列在两种相关化合物旁边。

entries.en: The damaged panel contained an aminoplast beneath its outer coating.
entries.zh: 受损面板的外涂层下面含有一种氨基塑料。

entries.en: The chemist examined the bonding in an ammine complex.
entries.zh: 化学家考察了一种氨络物中的成键情况。

entries.en: She added dried ammobium to the wreath above the doorway.
entries.zh: 她把干银苞菊添进了门上方的花环。

entries.en: The coloured diagram distinguishes the amnion from the surrounding membranes.
entries.zh: 彩色示意图区分了羊膜与周围的膜。

entries.en: The exercise asks whether the pictured animal is an amniote.
entries.zh: 练习要求判断图中的动物是不是羊膜动物。

entries.en: The textbook devotes a full chapter to Amphibia.
entries.zh: 这本教材用整整一章介绍两栖类。

entries.en: Dark amphibole crystals stood out against the lighter minerals.
entries.zh: 深色角闪石晶体在较浅的矿物衬托下十分显眼。

entries.en: The geologist collected amphibolite from the newly exposed rock face.
entries.zh: 地质学家从新露出的岩面上采集了闪岩。

entries.en: The botanist compared the amphidiploid with both parent plants.
entries.zh: 植物学家把这个双二倍体与两个亲本植物进行了比较。

entries.en: The students examined a preserved amphioxus under magnification.
entries.zh: 学生们放大观察了一条保存的文昌鱼标本。

entries.en: A tiny amphipod swam out from beneath the seaweed.
entries.zh: 一只微小的片脚类动物从海藻下面游了出来。

entries.en: The study measured amygdalin in several prepared seed extracts.
entries.zh: 这项研究测量了几份制备好的种子提取物中的苦杏苷。

entries.en: The historical recipe lists amylum among the paper-making ingredients.
entries.zh: 这份历史配方把淀粉列为造纸原料之一。

entries.en: The microbiologist kept the anaerobe away from air during the experiment.
entries.zh: 实验期间，微生物学家让这种厌氧菌与空气隔绝。

entries.en: The display included a reconstruction of an anaspid.
entries.zh: 展览中有一件缺甲类动物的复原模型。

entries.en: A life-sized anatotitan model towered above the visitors.
entries.zh: 一座与实物等大的大鸭龙模型高高矗立在参观者上方。

entries.en: The lecturer discussed the anatoxin in a historical account of vaccine research.
entries.zh: 讲师在回顾疫苗研究历史时讨论了这种类毒素。

entries.en: Blue anchusa flowers brightened the corner beside the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 蓝色的牛舌草花使温室旁的角落明亮起来。

entries.en: The rock sample contained andesite with several visible crystals.
entries.zh: 这份岩石样本含有安山岩，其中可见几颗晶体。

entries.en: She turned the andradite slowly beneath the display light.
entries.zh: 她在展示灯下缓缓转动那颗钙铁榴石。

entries.en: The analyst checked the androsterone measurements against the control results.
entries.zh: 分析员把雄甾酮的测量值与对照结果进行了核对。

entries.en: The botanist examined the fruit of an angiocarp.
entries.zh: 植物学家检查了一株果实有壳的植物的果实。

entries.en: An angiopteris spread its fronds beside the stream.
entries.zh: 一株莲座蕨在溪边舒展着叶片。

entries.en: The aquarium guide showed us a photograph of an anglerfish.
entries.zh: 水族馆讲解员给我们看了一张琵琶鱼的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 前翅边缘有凹痕的蝴蝶
entries.en: An anglewing rested on the railing with its wings folded.
entries.zh: 一只前翅边缘有凹痕的蝴蝶合着翅膀停在栏杆上。

entries.en: An angleworm wriggled through the damp soil beneath the pot.
entries.zh: 一条蚯蚓在花盆下面的湿土中蠕动。

entries.en: The old cabinet held a labelled packet of angostura.
entries.zh: 旧柜子里有一包贴着标签的安古斯图拉树皮。

entries.en: The film shows an angwantibo moving among the branches.
entries.zh: 影片中，一只金熊猴在树枝间活动。

entries.en: An anhinga dried its wings on a branch above the water.
entries.zh: 一只美洲蛇鸟在水面上方的树枝上晾干翅膀。

entries.en: The early observer drew an animalcule beside his handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 那位早期观察者在手写笔记旁画了一只微动物。

entries.en: The illustration shows an animalculum viewed through a simple microscope.
entries.zh: 插图显示了通过简易显微镜观察到的一个微生物。

entries.en: The artist gave the ankylosaur a heavily armoured back.
entries.zh: 画家给画中的甲龙画上了厚重的背甲。

entries.en: Children gathered around the ankylosaurus skeleton in the central gallery.
entries.zh: 孩子们围在中央展厅的甲龙骨架旁。

entries.en: The zoologist counted the segments of the annelid.
entries.zh: 动物学家数了数这只环节动物的体节。

entries.en: An anoa emerged from the trees near the enclosure fence.
entries.zh: 一头小野牛从围栏附近的树丛中走了出来。

entries.en: The mineral report identifies anorthite in the pale grains.
entries.zh: 矿物报告认定这些浅色颗粒中含有钙长石。

entries.en: We heard an antbird calling from the dense undergrowth.
entries.zh: 我们听见一只蚁鸟在茂密的灌丛中鸣叫。

entries.en: The student labelled the antheridiophore in her plant diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在她画的植物示意图中标出了精子器载体。

entries.en: The enlarged drawing reveals the shape of an antheridium.
entries.zh: 放大的图画显示了藏精器的形状。

entries.en: The animation follows an antherozoid as it moves through water.
entries.zh: 动画跟随一个隐花植物的游动精子，展示其在水中的运动。

entries.en: The museum placed anthophyllite beside other amphibole specimens.
entries.zh: 博物馆把直闪石放在其他角闪石标本旁边。

entries.en: The photograph captures an anthozoan with its tentacles extended.
entries.zh: 照片拍下了一只伸展触手的珊瑚虫。

entries.en: The old pharmacy catalogue contains an entry for an antiacid.
entries.zh: 这本旧药房目录列有一种抗酸剂。

entries.en: The chemist repeated the reaction without the anticatalyst.
entries.zh: 化学家在不加反催化剂的情况下重复了反应。

entries.en: The engineering archive includes an early advertisement for an antiknock.
entries.zh: 工程档案中收录了一则早期抗爆剂广告。

entries.en: The medical museum displayed a sealed vial of antivenene.
entries.zh: 医学博物馆展出了一支密封的抗蛇毒素小瓶。

entries.en: An antlion waited at the bottom of the sandy pit.
entries.zh: 一只蚁狮在沙坑底部等待着。

entries.en: The aoudad stood on a rocky ledge above the enclosure.
entries.zh: 那头鬣羊站在围场上方的一处岩石突沿上。

entries.en: The jeweller rejected the scratched apatite but kept the larger stone.
entries.zh: 珠宝商没有要那颗有划痕的磷灰石，却留下了较大的那颗石头。

entries.en: The exhibition compares an apatosaur with a much smaller dinosaur.
entries.zh: 展览把虚幻龙与一种小得多的恐龙作了比较。

entries.en: The field camera recorded an aperea near the grass-covered bank.
entries.zh: 野外相机拍到了一只出现在长满草的岸边附近的野豚鼠。

entries.en: The student needed a microscope to examine the aphanite.
entries.zh: 学生需要用显微镜来观察这块隐晶岩。

entries.en: A narrow band of aplite crossed the darker rock.
entries.zh: 一条细窄的细晶岩带穿过深色岩石。

entries.en: The dissection drawing marks an apodeme beneath the insect's outer surface.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了昆虫外表面下面的一处表皮内突。

entries.en: The researcher stored the apoenzyme separately from its coenzyme.
entries.zh: 研究人员把脱辅基酶蛋白与其辅酶分开保存。

entries.en: The botanist monitored an apomict throughout the growing season.
entries.zh: 植物学家在整个生长季中观察了一株无配偶生殖植物。

entries.en: She photographed an apothecium on the lichen's surface.
entries.zh: 她拍下了地衣表面的一个子囊盘。

entries.en: Fresh applemint grew in a pot beside the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 厨房窗边的花盆里长着鲜嫩的圆叶薄荷。

entries.en: The nocturnal exhibit included footage of an apteryx.
entries.zh: 夜行动物展区中播放了几维鸟的影像。

entries.en: White aragonite formed a delicate crust inside the cavity.
entries.zh: 白色霰石在空腔内部形成了一层精细的壳。

entries.en: A tall araucaria stood beyond the school's main gate.
entries.zh: 一棵高大的南洋杉矗立在学校大门外。

entries.en: The historical paper describes an arborvirus recovered during the survey.
entries.zh: 这篇历史论文描述了调查期间分离出的一种虫媒病毒。

entries.en: The research team compared two strains of the arbovirus.
entries.zh: 研究团队比较了这种虫媒病毒的两个毒株。

entries.en: An arbutus grew against the sheltered wall of the garden.
entries.zh: 一棵野草莓树生长在花园中避风的墙边。

entries.en: Archaebacteria occupy a separate section in this older textbook.
entries.zh: 原始细菌在这本较早的教材中占有单独一节。

entries.en: The technician isolated an archaebacterium from the culture.
entries.zh: 技术员从培养物中分离出了一种原始细菌。

entries.en: The laboratory kept its archaeobacteria in a separate incubator.
entries.zh: 实验室把古细菌放在单独的培养箱里培养。

entries.en: The fossil of an archaeopteryx drew a crowd of visitors.
entries.zh: 一件始祖鸟化石吸引了一群参观者。

entries.en: The biology student enlarged her sketch of an archegonium.
entries.zh: 生物专业的学生把她画的藏卵器草图放大了。

entries.en: The diagram shows the archenteron inside the developing embryo.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了发育中胚胎内部的原肠消化腔。

entries.en: The preserved research notes distinguish archeobacteria from the other samples.
entries.zh: 保存下来的研究笔记把古细菌与其他样本区分开来。

entries.en: An archerfish sent a jet of water towards the insect.
entries.zh: 一条射水鱼朝那只昆虫喷出了一股水。

entries.en: The researcher outlined the archesporium in the magnified image.
entries.zh: 研究人员在放大的图像中勾出了孢原组织的轮廓。

entries.en: The dyer tested archil on a small piece of cloth.
entries.zh: 染工在一小块布上试用了苔色素。

entries.en: The sculptor consulted fossil drawings before modelling the archosaur.
entries.zh: 雕塑家在制作祖龙模型前查阅了化石图。

entries.en: An arctiid landed on the pale wall beside the lamp.
entries.zh: 一只灯蛾落在了灯旁的浅色墙面上。

entries.en: A young areca stood between two taller palms.
entries.zh: 一棵幼小的槟榔树长在两棵较高的棕榈树之间。

entries.en: The virologist reviewed the arenavirus results before the meeting.
entries.zh: 病毒学家在开会前查看了沙粒病毒的检测结果。

entries.en: The old engraving depicts an argal on a mountain slope.
entries.zh: 这幅旧版画描绘了一头山坡上的盘羊。

entries.en: We spotted an argali through binoculars across the valley.
entries.zh: 我们通过望远镜看到了山谷另一边的一头盘羊。

entries.en: The gardener wore thick gloves while moving the argemone.
entries.zh: 园丁移栽蓟罂粟时戴着厚手套。

entries.en: The child drew an argentinosaur stretching across two sheets of paper.
entries.zh: 孩子画了一只阿根廷龙，画面占了两张纸。

entries.en: The mining collection includes argentite from an abandoned shaft.
entries.zh: 采矿藏品中有来自一处废弃矿井的辉银矿。

entries.en: The potter kneaded the argil before shaping a small bowl.
entries.zh: 陶工先揉好白黏土，再制作一个小碗。

entries.en: The historical display paired each argonon with its chemical symbol.
entries.zh: 历史展览把每种惰性气体与其化学符号配对列出。

entries.en: A small argyrodite specimen gleamed beneath the cabinet light.
entries.zh: 一小块硫银锗矿标本在展柜灯下闪着光。

entries.en: The analyst measured acetic acid in the diluted vinegar sample.
entries.zh: 分析员测量了稀释醋样中的乙酸。

entries.en: Green algae covered the stones beneath the shallow water.
entries.zh: 绿藻覆盖了浅水下的石头。

entries.en: An alley cat sheltered beneath the restaurant's delivery steps.
entries.zh: 一只野猫躲在餐馆送货台阶下面。

entries.en: The worksheet asks us to draw an amino acid.
entries.zh: 练习纸要求我们画出一种氨基酸。

entries.en: The documentary examines the athlete's use of an anabolic steroid.
entries.zh: 纪录片考察了这名运动员使用合成代谢类固醇的情况。

entries.en: The food laboratory compared ascorbic acid levels in the samples.
entries.zh: 食品实验室比较了这些样本中的抗坏血酸含量。

entries.en: The students observed bacteria through the laboratory microscope.
entries.zh: 学生们通过实验室的显微镜观察了细菌。

entries.en: She checked the date on the baking powder before mixing the batter.
entries.zh: 搅拌面糊前，她查看了发酵粉上的日期。

entries.en: He measured the baking soda into a small bowl.
entries.zh: 他把称量好的小苏打放进了一个小碗。

entries.en: A bald eagle circled above the far end of the lake.
entries.zh: 一只白头鹰在湖的远端上空盘旋。

entries.en: The ornament was made from a base metal rather than silver.
entries.zh: 这件装饰品是用贱金属而非白银制作的。

entries.en: Our basset hound slept with its ears spread across the cushion.
entries.zh: 我们家的短腿猎犬睡着了，耳朵摊在坐垫上。

entries.en: The bath water had cooled by the time she returned.
entries.zh: 她回来时，洗澡水已经凉了。

entries.en: The farmer loaded the sacks onto a beast of burden.
entries.zh: 农民把袋子装到了一头驮畜背上。

entries.en: The cupboard held flour, salt, and bicarbonate of soda.
entries.zh: 橱柜里放着面粉、盐和小苏打。

entries.en: The big cat disappeared into the long grass before sunset.
entries.zh: 日落前，那只大型猫科动物消失在高草丛中。

entries.en: The museum examines the history of hunting big game.
entries.zh: 博物馆探讨了狩猎大型猎物的历史。

entries.en: A billy goat pushed its head through the fence.
entries.zh: 一只雄山羊把头伸过了篱笆。

entries.en: The artist painted a bird of paradise with its feathers displayed.
entries.zh: 画家画了一只展示羽毛的极乐鸟。

entries.en: The driver slowed down after noticing black ice on the bridge.
entries.zh: 司机发现桥上的透明薄冰后减慢了车速。

entries.en: She pressed blotting paper gently onto the fresh signature.
entries.zh: 她把吸墨纸轻轻按在刚签好的名字上。

entries.en: A blue tit darted from the feeder to the hedge.
entries.zh: 一只蓝冠山雀从喂鸟器飞快地飞向树篱。

entries.en: They invested in bricks and mortar instead of shares.
entries.zh: 他们投资了房产，而不是股票。

entries.en: The historical medical kit contained a bottle labelled carbolic acid.
entries.zh: 这套历史医疗用品中有一瓶标着石炭酸的瓶子。
